research_question: Does a validated procedure provide 95% simultaneous coverage for all horizons of the fixed-eight-country Panel LP paths under the completed research program?

scope.current_research_program: current fitted dynamic model and tested Gaussian/bootstrap/studentization procedure family

methods_attempted.method: Frozen-standard-error Gaussian max-t joint critical values

best_method: GVAR-type joint model residual bootstrap-t pathwise simultaneous band; best observed pooled result remains below nominal coverage and is not activated.

r2_outcome_summary.cn_lookup_review: The locked c(n) lookup covers n=150-250; at unemployment n=148 the analysis returned no value while independent review computed 142. This post-hoc review discrepancy does not change any activation decision or the NOT CONFIRMED verdict.

solver_limitations: HICP stopped at the registered invalid-stop boundary after 150 completed outer panels.
Unemployment ended at 148 outer panels with 13 unavailable solver fits.
Across R2 there were 17 unavailable fits: 15 Newton iteration-limit and 2 Newton-budget cases; unavailable results counted against coverage.
Convergence and numerical availability were evaluated separately from statistical coverage.
model_fit_limitations: The fitted GVAR-type ARX13 model did not reproduce the Industrial Production monetary-policy group-difference path at horizons about 18-21; the gap is about 3.9 frozen standard errors.
The fit is a descriptive population-projection comparison, not a structural impulse response or forecast.
Model applicability and coverage adequacy are separate gates.
post_hoc_decisions: R2 used 250 outer panels per outcome instead of the original 10000-per-design target.
R2 used a one-sided per-path rule u=.92, an outcome guard .935 and partial activation instead of the original two-sided [.935,.965] rule.
Null-difference size and power designs were omitted; difference paths were ineligible.
The t5, seasonal-dependence and heterogeneous-dynamics stress designs were not tested.
Independent second bootstrap implementation was replaced by independent recomputation of stored statistics plus a determinism rerun.
Fresh-seed solver validation was replaced by availability measured during confirmation, with unavailable fits counted as non-coverage.
B=999 and solver v4 were retained after the S4 pilot; these were post-hoc scope choices.
The .90 futility threshold, difference-path ineligibility and Industrial Production MP adequacy warning were set after S4 results were observed.
The per-outcome family-wise calibrated applicability gate was post hoc.
